notes: Microsoft lists MAI-Voice-2.1-Flash as Public Preview: text/SSML input, speech audio output, and 23 languages. Optional voice cloning accepts a 5-60 second reference clip; this proxy template exposes standard synthesis, not voice cloning.
The published Speech meter is USD 15 per 1M characters in the listed regions. The generic price row does not establish availability in every Speech region.
No exact deployment modelVersion, text-input ceiling, context window, or output-token limit is published; character billing does not establish token limits.
Native Azure Speech synthesis uses /cognitiveservices/v1 and selects the model in the voice name. The configured audio/speech route is a proxy adapter to Speech, not an Azure OpenAI endpoint.
